instructions.title: Cake
items: Mix all ingredients together until smooth, pour into a greased pan.
Bake in a 9x13 pan for 35-40 minutes, or in a large cookie sheet for 30-35 minutes, at 350°F.

instructions.title: Cream cheese frosting
items: Cream together the cream cheese, butter, and vanilla.
Add sugar gradually, adding milk as needed. Beat until smooth and creamy.
*It is roughly 6-8 carrots, and I use my food processor to chop them into tiny bits.
